More than a [[1030 BBY/Legends|thousand years]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] engaged the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Volfe Karkko]] in a '''lightsaber duel''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] '''Kiffex'''. After a fierce duel, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were able to subdue Karkko. Rather than kill him, however, he was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis field]] and left to contemplate his fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].
